flicks.text: Aujourd’hui, j’ai commandé un café en français pour la première fois !
flicks.tr: Today I ordered a coffee in French for the first time!
flicks.cap: Small win in a Paris café. Merci Camille for the practice!
comments: Bravo Kenji ! Ton français progresse vite.

flicks.text: Finally watched a whole film in English without subtitles.
flicks.tr: J’ai enfin regardé un film entier en anglais sans sous-titres.
flicks.cap: Any film recommendations for my next challenge?
comments: Try Paddington 2, the English is clear and it’s funny.

flicks.text: ¿Cuál es la palabra más bonita en tu idioma?
flicks.tr: What is the most beautiful word in your language?
flicks.cap: Mine is “madrugada”, the hours after midnight before sunrise.
comments: 木漏れ日 (komorebi): sunlight through the leaves.

flicks.text: ほんま？ is the Osaka way to say “really?”
flicks.cap: Three more Osaka phrases in my class on Tuesday.
